findings.message: The migration approach slide (position 1) does not connect explicitly to the incidents catalogued in the before-state slide. A reader skimming headlines cannot follow the causal chain from 'fragmented pipelines' to 'shadow mode rollout' without re-reading body copy. Add a bridging sentence to the approach slide header.

The phrase '62% latency reduction' appears verbatim on both the results slide (position 2) and the ask slide (position 3). Remove the duplication from the ask slide and replace with a reference such as 'the Q3 gains described above'.
